chapter_seo_title: Heavenly Burial Valley Opens – Skeleton Kings and Qingqing Reappear
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen lures enemy kings into the awakened Heavenly Burial Valley. Treasures, ancient horrors, and shocking reappearances of the three skeleton kings and a Qingqing lookalike shake the foundations of reality.
og_title: Heavenly Burial Valley: Reunions and Nightmares
og_description: The stele rises, the valley opens, and Xiao Chen finds himself face to face with old allies and terrifying mysteries. A chapter of strategy, horror, and revelation.
